instruction: Candid medium shot in a bright modern room with white shelves. On a black leather sofa, the bald man in the black polo shirt (R2) sits on the left, leaning his head on his hand and looking directly at his companion. On the right, the blonde woman in the blue floral blouse (R1) sits with her legs crossed, raising both hands expressively in the air and speaking with an animated, smiling expression. The two are seated close together on the L-shaped sofa. Soft, natural indoor light from a window on the right illuminates the clean, neutral-toned setting with a shallow depth of field.
